definition: a children's game in which one player tries to find the others, who are hidden; hide-and-seek.
example_en: The children were playing hide-and-seek in the courtyard.

definition: harsh, pungent speech. characterised by ruthlessness.
example_en: Hearing his harsh words, she cried.

definition: a parti-coloured carpet.
example_en: A beautiful parti-coloured carpet had been spread in his room.

definition: to become wider or broader; (vastness) to increase.
example_en: As evening fell, the darkness grew wider.

definition: to turn (something); to twist.
example_en: He twisted the wire with his hand.

definition: the outer skin of the tamarind fruit.
example_en: The children peeled off the tamarind skin and played.

definition: (astron.) a most conspicuous northern constellation between Lynx and Draco, which contains more than 50 visible stars, seven of which form the Big Dipper; the Great Bear; the Ursa Major.
example: ರಾತ್ರಿಯ ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಪ್ತಋಷಿ ನಕ್ಷತ್ರಪುಂಜ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The constellation of the Great Bear is clearly visible in the night sky.

definition: a flowing of blood from the injured, wounded part of the body.
example_en: Because blood was flowing from the wound, they called the doctor.

definition: a liquid food, as of oatmeal etc., boiled in sour buttermilk.
example_en: In summer, grandmother used to prepare and give kunjala.

definition: belonging or relating to the qualities as ignorance, passion, wickedness, selfishness, greediness, etc.
example: ಆತನ ರಾಜಸ ಸ್ವಭಾವ ಅವನನ್ನು ದುರಾಸೆಯತ್ತ ಒಯ್ಯಿತು.
example_en: His passionate, greedy nature led him toward avarice.

definition: a cylindrical case of cardboard, metal, etc. containing the charge and primer, and usu. the projectile, for a firearm; a cartridge.
example_en: The soldier loaded a new cartridge into the gun.

definition: a place, distant from the native land, where a group of people settle but remain under the political jurisdiction of their native land; a colony.
example_en: That region was a Portuguese colony.

definition: to become lose, slack.
example_en: Drying in the sun, the rope became slack.

definition: a protoplasmic particle or cell with a special function, esp. any of the erythrocytes (red corpuscles) or leukocytes (white corpuscles) that float in the blood, lymph, etc.; a blood corpuscles.
example_en: If the number of blood corpuscles decreases, the body becomes weak.

definition: love; affection.
example_en: The love between brother and sister never diminished.

definition: the act of joining two or more things together or associating oneself with another or others.
example: ಎರಡು ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳ ಮಿಲಾವಣೆಯಿಂದ ಹೊಸ ಕಂಪನಿ ಹುಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: A new company arose from the joining of two organizations.

definition: to change one's place; to move; to go.
example_en: That family moved to another town.

definition: the annual plant Raphanus sativus of Brassicaceae family; radish plant.
example_en: She made radish sambar.

definition: a man who has invested capital in a business enterprise; an investor; a capitalist.
example_en: That capitalist is the owner of many factories.

definition: (myth.) Yama, the God of Death.
example: ಪರೇತಪತಿಯು ಪ್ರಾಣಿಗಳ ಆತ್ಮವನ್ನು ತನ್ನ ಲೋಕಕ್ಕೆ ಕರೆದೊಯ್ಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: Yama, the God of Death, takes the souls of beings to his world.

definition: the act or an instance of stealing; theft.
example_en: A theft took place in the bank.

definition: the vine Cucumis sativus of Cucurbitaceae family.
example_en: The farmer planted a cucumber vine in the garden.

definition: a reduction from a usual or list price or a deduction from a debt, allowed for paying promptly or in cash; discount.
example_en: The students received a discount in the fee.

definition: (dial.) a thicket of shrubs.
example_en: A dense thicket of shrubs had grown behind the house.

definition: a vedic scholar.
example_en: That scholar is a renowned vedic expert.

definition: the sexual union; copulation; coitus.
example_en: A child was born from the sexual union.

definition: brightly; brilliantly; sparklingly.
example_en: Her bangles glittered brilliantly.

definition: a kind of superior quality cloth.
example: ಆ ಬಟ್ಟೆಯ ಅಂಗಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬನ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Superior quality cloth is available at that cloth shop.

definition: to shout or call out noisily; to bawl; to talk with uncontrolled wrath; to rave.
example_en: He shouted in anger.

definition: a caste in the Malenāḍu of Karnāṭaka, the members of which work as slaves and also draw toddy from various trees.
example: ಮಲೆನಾಡಿನ ದೀವರು ತೆಂಗಿನ ಮರದಿಂದ ಸೇಂದಿ ಇಳಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: The Divaru people of Malenadu drew toddy from the coconut tree.

definition: the instalment that is due for payment, but not paid.
example_en: The shopkeeper reminded him of the unpaid instalment.

definition: to become folded or wrinkled.
example_en: The old paper had become folded and crumpled.

definition: a taking care of trees, and other plants in a forest.
example_en: Taking care of trees and plants in the forest is very important.

definition: (vīr.) the phallus of Śiva, considered as one's teacher, guide.
example_en: The devotees worshipped the guru linga with devotion.

definition: Śiva, the enemy of Kāma, the Love-God.
example_en: Devotees worship Kāvavageya, the enemy of Kāma.

definition: the fact of not recurring; non-recurrence.
example_en: This agreement ensured the non-recurrence (of the problem).

definition: not having the sense of shame; shameless.
example_en: That shameless man has no sense of shame at all.

definition: a village, town.
example_en: The people of the village lead a simple life.

definition: a small window or ventilator.
example_en: Air was coming in through the small window of the room.

definition: to shear or cause to be split into (several) pieces.
example_en: They sheared the cloth into pieces with scissors.

definition: ambrosia, as the food.
example_en: Ambrosia is offered to the gods as their food.

definition: phlegm, one of the three humours of the body.
example: ಆಯುರ್ವೇದದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಶ್ಲೇಷ್ಮ ದೇಹದ ಮೂರು ಧಾತುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು.
example_en: According to Ayurveda, phlegm is one of the three humours of the body.

definition: a screaming, in a thin voice, from pain.
example_en: His thin scream of pain was heard by everyone.

definition: to take or clasp in the arms and press to the bosom; to hug; to embrace.
example_en: The mother embraced the child lovingly.

definition: to decide firmly upon; to determine.
example_en: She determined firmly to study.

definition: a variety in basil of Laminaceae family; wild basil.
example_en: Wild basil grows naturally at the edge of the forest.

definition: joined; jointed; combined.
example: ಎರಡು ಭಾಗಗಳು ಪರಿಮಿಲಿತವಾಗಿ ಒಂದೇ ಆಕಾರ ಪಡೆದವು.
example_en: The two parts were joined together and took a single shape.

definition: to cause to grow, expand or progress.
example_en: Good nourishment makes the crop grow and progress.

definition: any of a large number of small, widespread rodents belonging to various families and having small ears and a long, thin tail, esp., a species (Mus musculus) that commonly infests buildings; a mouse.
example_en: The cat chased the mouse running in the kitchen.

definition: a person who is supposed to use an evil supernatural power over people and their affairs; a wizard; a sorcerer.
example_en: The villagers kept away from that sorcerer out of fear.

definition: the act or process of supporting or the condition of being supported; support.
example_en: The work would not have finished without the friend's support.

definition: a piece of land surrounded by water; an island.
example: ಆ ಕುಱವವನ್ನು ದೋಣಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಮಾತ್ರ ತಲುಪಬಹುದು.
example_en: That island can be reached only by boat.

definition: falling short of perfection; defective; imperfect; not satisfying; being erroneous; faulty.
example_en: The working of this machine is defective.

definition: articulated with the back of the tongue touching or near the soft palate; velar.
example_en: The sound 'ka' is considered a velar sound.

definition: to speak loudly.
example: ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಮುಂದೆ ಗಟ್ಟಿಸಿ ಪಾಠ ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The teacher spoke the lesson loudly in front of the children.

definition: the plant Paspalum scrobiculatum ( = P. fumentaceum) of Poaceae family.
example_en: They grow unnala plant in this field.

definition: certainly; surely.
example_en: He will certainly win.

definition: to attract - a) to draw to oneself; b) to get the attention; to allure; to charm.
example_en: Her words attracted and charmed everyone.

definition: anguish; distress; discomfort; pain.
example_en: She could not escape distress in her life of poverty.

definition: concentration - a) the act of concentrating; the state of being concentrated; b) exclusive attention to one object; close mental application.
example_en: Concentration is necessary in meditation.

definition: a kind of poison.
example: ಬಲಾಹ ಎಂಬ ವಿಷವನ್ನು ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ವೈದ್ಯರು ತಿಳಿದಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: Ancient physicians knew about the poison called balaha.

definition: a forest; jungle; woods.
example: ಹಳುವದ ನಡುವೆ ಒಂದು ಶಾಂತ ಸರೋವರ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a quiet lake amid the forest.

definition: the acting of pulling towards; attraction.
example_en: There was an attraction in that light.

definition: the quality or condition of being twisted, turned or coiled.
example_en: The rope became twisted and coiled, making it hard to untangle.

definition: washed clothes.
example_en: She dried the washed clothes on the rope.

definition: to behave, deal with, dishonestly for one's own gain; to defraud.
example_en: He defrauded me and took the money.

definition: Ādiśeṣa, the king of serpents.
example_en: In the puranas, Adishesha, the king of serpents, appears as Vishnu's bed.

definition: a large bird belonging to the variety of heron; wild heron.
example: ಕಾಡುಬಕ ಕೆರೆಯ ಆಳ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೀನು ಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The wild heron catches fish in the deep water of the lake.

definition: the measure of that which is too long or tall.
example: ಆ ಮರದ ಕಟ್ಟುದ್ದವನ್ನು ಅಳೆಯಲು ಉದ್ದವಾದ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿದರು.
example_en: They used a long tape to measure the excessive height of that tree.

definition: red hair.
example_en: That boy had red hair.

definition: either of the pointed extremities of a moustache.
example_en: The pointed ends of his moustache were well twirled.

definition: a common sedimentary rock consisting of sand, usu. quartz, cemented together by various substances, as silica, lime, iron oxide or clay; sand-stone.
example_en: This building is constructed with sandstone.

definition: anything that is inevitable, unavoidable, etc. as a result of natural law; that which is necessary in natural sequence; necessity; a need.
example_en: Death is an inevitable necessity for everyone.

definition: a heavy blow.
example_en: He defeated the enemy by dealing a heavy blow.

definition: the quality of being righteous; virtuousness; righteousness.
example_en: His righteousness earned everyone's respect.

definition: a well trained rider of a horse; a jockey.
example_en: The skilled horseman rode the horse with great skill.

definition: a kind of bugle.
example_en: The sound of the bugle resounded on the battlefield.

definition: a woman who shows or has religious devotion or reverence for; she who adores or venerates another as a deity ; a worshipper.
example_en: That female devotee used to go to the temple every day.

definition: soft creamy mud.
example_en: The children made a doll from the soft creamy mud.

definition: the act of informing.
example: ಬಾಗಿಲ ಗಂಟೆಯ ಸೂಚಕ ಅತಿಥಿ ಬಂದದ್ದನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The indicator of the doorbell informed that a guest had arrived.

definition: a man versed with Vedas.
example: ಗುರುಗಳು ಒಬ್ಬ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ಚಾಂದಸ ಎಂದು ಹೆಸರಾಗಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: The teacher was renowned as a great scholar versed in the Vedas.

definition: a supervising or overseeing.
example_en: The supervision of the work did not proceed properly.

definition: The plant Premna longifolia of Verbenaceae family.
example_en: They use the leaves of the kaduku plant for medicine.

definition: the sun.
example_en: As soon as the sun rose, the dew melted.

definition: an optical counterpart or appearance of an object, as is produced by reflection from a mirror, a shining surface, unperturbed water, etc.; an image.
example_en: The reflection of the tree appeared in the pond water.

definition: an evil spirit; a devil; a demon.
example: ಪುರಾಣ ಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಸುರ ದೇವತೆಗಳ ಜೊತೆ ಯುದ್ಧ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: In the mythological story, the demon fought with the gods.

definition: a large group of soldiers; a battalion.
example_en: The battalion camped at the foot of the hill.

definition: to remove seeds from (cotton) with a gin; to gin.
example_en: The workers ginned the cotton with the machine.

definition: that which has been handed down form generation to generation; a tradition.
example_en: This custom has come down through our tradition.

definition: free from danger; not subject to injury, damage, loss or pain.
example_en: This medicine is free from danger to the body.

definition: a priest in a village temple (esp. of a folk-god).
example: ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ದೇವಾಲಯದ ಬೊಪ್ಪಿ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಪೂಜೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: The boppi of that village temple performs worship every day.

definition: a woman belonging to Tamil Nadu, in south India or a Tamil-speaking woman chiefly in Tamil Nadu or Sri Lanka.
example_en: A Tamil woman helped us.

definition: to fall short of; to be deficient; to be incomplete.
example_en: The share of rice has fallen short.

definition: the act, process of punishing (a person for wrong deed or deeds); chastisement.
example: ತಪ್ಪು ಮಾಡಿದ ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ತಂಬಿ ಕೊಡುವುದು ಅಗತ್ಯವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Punishment was necessary for the child who had done wrong.

definition: a man who moves, rides (very) fast.
example_en: The fast-moving prince rode the horse swiftly.

definition: to pack in a cover, bag, container, etc.
example_en: He packed the clothes tightly into the bag.

definition: a place where people take refuge; an asylum.
example_en: That town was a refuge for the homeless.

definition: a royal litter or palanquin.
example_en: The king was carried in a royal litter.

definition: to lose courage, resoluteness.
example_en: Hearing the news of defeat, he lost courage.

definition: a very young child; a baby; an infant.
example_en: The infant began to cry from hunger.

definition: the state of or of being, a whore.
example_en: Poverty pushed her into prostitution.

definition: the wind, the carrier of fragrances.
example_en: The wind carried the fragrance of jasmine far away.

definition: the firm flesh surrounding the alveolar parts of the jaws on the inside of the mouth and surrounding the base of the teeth; the alveolar portion of a jaw with its enveloping soft tissues; the gum.
example_en: Blood came from the gum while brushing the teeth.

definition: the art or profession of making dolls and other handicraft items out of wood.
example_en: The craft of wood-carving is famous in that town.

definition: a plant disease at the time of yielding.
example_en: The crop got the yield-time disease and the produce decreased.

definition: the plant Berberis aristata of Berberidaceae family; Indian barbery.
example_en: The root of the Indian barberry plant is used as medicine.

definition: a kind of semi-divine being or fairy.
example_en: In the story, the fairy-like being rose up from the sea.

definition: nourished; reared well.
example: ಆ ಮಗು ತಾಯಿಯ ಆರೈಕೆಯಿಂದ ಪರಿಪೋಷಿತ ಆಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: That child grew up well nourished under the mother's care.

definition: a kind of trap for small animals, consisting of a noose; a snare.
example_en: The hunter set a snare in the forest.

definition: a skin disease characterised by whitish, reddish or blackish spots.
example_en: After treatment, the skin disease gradually healed.

definition: the measurement of the intensity of the light; photometry.
example: ವಿಜ್ಞಾನಿಗಳು ದ್ಯುತಿಮಾಪನದ ಮೂಲಕ ಬೆಳಕಿನ ತೀವ್ರತೆಯನ್ನು ಅಳೆದರು.
example_en: The scientists measured the intensity of light through photometry.

definition: a feast; a festival.
example_en: A big festival is taking place in the village today.

definition: a sum of money one has.
example_en: He had a small sum of money on hand.

definition: amounting to one hundred forty.
example: ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಈರೆೞ್ಪತ್ತು ಮನೆಗಳಿವೆ ಎಂದು ಹಳೆಯ ಗ್ರಂಥ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The old text says there are one hundred forty houses in that village.

definition: a cluster of peaks in a range of mountains.
example_en: From a distance, the cluster of mountain peaks looked beautiful.

definition: a kind of ear disease, characterised by exudation of a pus-like liquid from the affected ear.
example_en: The doctor examined the ear disease with pus discharge.

definition: a tight clasping; an embrace.
example_en: The two friends embraced each other joyfully in a tight clasp.

definition: a small quantity of ash, infused with magical power of keeping another or others spellbound, submissive etc.
example_en: He brought the villagers under his spell with the magic ash.

definition: a person who earns a living by farming; a farmer.
example: ಆ ಕಿಸಾನ ತನ್ನ ಜಮೀನಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಗೋಧಿ ಬೆಳೆದನು.
example_en: That farmer grew wheat on his land.

definition: to attack with a military force.
example_en: The enemies sent an army to attack the city.

definition: short underpants worn by men or boys.
example: ಬೇಸಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನು ಅರೆಚಡ್ಡಿ ಧರಿಸಿ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಓಡಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: In summer, he wore short underpants and moved about the house.

definition: the tree Gmelina arborea (Premna arborea) of Verbenaceae family; white teak.
example_en: The cattle rested under the white teak tree.

definition: the behavior or an act of a rogue; roguery; wickedness.
example_en: That man's roguery was known to everyone in the village.

definition: the weed Argygeia nervosa ( = A. speciosa) of Convolvulaceae family; Linden silver weed.
example_en: The leaves of the Linden silver weed are used for medicine.

definition: the sun setting in the evening.
example_en: At sunset the sky looked red.

definition: a clasping or being clasped tightly; an embrace.
example_en: Their embrace showed the depth of their love.

definition: one who kills; a killer; a murderer.
example_en: The police arrested that killer.

definition: a paste, plaster, cement, used by sculptors.
example_en: The sculptor made the idol using a strong cement paste.

definition: a man who dies in protecting his religion; a religious martyr.
example: ಆ ಸೈನಿಕ ಧರ್ಮ ರಕ್ಷಣೆಗಾಗಿ ಪ್ರಾಣ ಕೊಟ್ಟು ಷಹೀದನಾದನು.
example_en: That soldier gave his life protecting his religion and became a martyr.

definition: a coarse, broad tape used in making cots.
example_en: The grandmother was weaving the coarse tape for the cot.

definition: to step backward; to go back.
example_en: The child stepped backward in fear.

definition: a device of wood, iron, rope etc. for going up or down by, often portable and consisting of two long uprights, connected by rungs or cross-pieces, which form steps; a ladder.
example_en: He climbed to the loft by placing a ladder.

definition: the end; finish; conclusion.
example: ಈ ಅಧ್ಯಾಯದ ವಿರತಿ ಓದುಗರಿಗೆ ಸಮಾಧಾನ ನೀಡಿತು.
example_en: The conclusion of this chapter gave the readers satisfaction.

definition: a prescribed rule; an authoritative direction; the act of prescribing a rule; a regulating or regulation.
example_en: All students must follow the school's prescribed rule.

definition: a fighter; a soldier.
example_en: That soldier fought bravely in the battle.

definition: the dead body of a human being or any other animal; corpse.
example_en: They brought home the corpse of the one who died in the accident.

definition: of, having or relating to, dimension or dimensions; dimensional.
example_en: This problem requires dimensional analysis.

definition: (dial.) a sick person.
example_en: They took the sick person to the hospital.

definition: the quality of being faint, dim; lack of intensity or brilliance.
example: ಆ ದೀಪದ ಬೆಳಕಿನ ಪೇಲವತೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಕಾಣಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The faintness of that lamp's light was visible to everyone.

definition: a boy or man as related to either or both of his parents; a male descendant; a son.
example_en: His son is studying in the town.

definition: the numerical result obtained by dividing the sum of two or more quantities by the number of such quantities; an arithmetic mean or average.
example_en: This year's average rainfall has decreased.

definition: a mean, wicked man.
example_en: Being a wicked man, he helped no one.

definition: conflict among kinsmen, cousins, caused by serious disagreements.
example_en: The conflict among kinsmen over property split the family apart.

definition: to make an indistinct sound (as in sawing) repeatedly.
example_en: While sawing the wood, a grating sound was heard.

definition: the jasmine plant Jasminum heyneanum ( = J.sambac).
example_en: The jasmine creeper spread over the fence.

definition: opinion given as to what to do or how to handle a situation; counsel; an advice.
example: ಗುರುಗಳು ನೀಡಿದ ಸಲಹಾ ಅವನ ಬಾಳನ್ನೇ ಬದಲಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The advice given by the teacher changed his whole life.

definition: the tree Sesbania paludosa of Paplionaceae family.
example_en: The leaves of the black sesbania look dark.

definition: the oil extracted from the flax seed (linseed).
example_en: Mother uses linseed oil in cooking.

definition: the state of being too subordinate or the behaviour of a subordinate person; subservience.
example_en: Even the master was disgusted by the servant's subservience.

definition: to enter in; to go or come in.
example_en: He opened the door to enter into the house.

definition: a kind of animal.
example: ಈ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಟ್ಟಗೆದಲು ಎಂಬ ಪ್ರಾಣಿ ಕಾಣಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: An animal called beṭṭagedalu is found in this region.

definition: an inlet of a sea where ships can anchor; a harbour.
example_en: Fishermen's boats stood at the harbour.

definition: temporary loss of one's bodily awareness, resulting from rapture, melody, tiredness, etc.; the state of being stupefied.
example_en: In the noon heat, drowsy stupor came over him.

definition: that lives, prevails, exists for a few seconds.
example: ಆ ಸಂತೋಷ ಕ್ಷಣಿಕವಾದದ್ದು ಎಂದು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: He knew that happiness was momentary.

definition: a kind of salt prepared by boiling down soda with emblic myrobolan.
example_en: Grandmother brought a little of the sanchala salt and kept it for medicine.

definition: the bag that contains the testicles; the scrotum.
example_en: The doctor examined the swelling of the scrotum.

definition: to think; to feel; to consider.
example: ಅವನು ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೊತ್ತು ಗಿಱಿದನು.
example_en: He thought over the problem for a while.

definition: of or belonging to, happened yesterday.
example_en: Everyone was talking about yesterday's meeting.

definition: the extended or annexed portion of city or town; an extension.
example_en: The city's extension is happening very fast.

definition: the act, fact or habit of repeating several times monotonously or uninterestingly the same what is said or made known.
example: ಅವನ ಉಜಳಣಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಜನರಿಗೆ ಬೇಸರವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: People grew tired of hearing his monotonous repetition.

definition: to lean on.
example_en: The tired old man walked leaning on his stick.

definition: unpleasantness; mental irritation.
example: ಈ ಸಣ್ಣ ವಿಷಯ ನನಗೆ ಕಿರ್ಕಿರಿ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: This small matter caused me irritation.

definition: to lose one's strength; to become weak or be defeated.
example_en: Walking in the sun, he became weak and lost his strength.

definition: to chose, select very carefully and discerningly.
example: ಈ ಬಣ್ಣ ಆ ಬಟ್ಟೆಗೆ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಏಱುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: This colour suits that cloth well.

definition: a rope or cord.
example_en: He tied the rope around the ox's neck.

definition: (people) to travel in large number.
example_en: The devotees travelled in large numbers to the temple.

definition: the sound of bellowing (as of a bull, bison, pig, etc.).
example_en: The bellowing of the cow was heard far away.

definition: the state of divine blessedness; salvation of the soul.
example_en: Saints long for the state of divine blessedness.

definition: a man lacking a sense of responsibility; an irresponsible fellow.
example: ಆ ಧಿಮ್ಮಾಲೆ ರಂಗ ತನ್ನ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಮಾಡದೆ ತಿರುಗಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: That irresponsible fellow wanders about without doing his work.

definition: to spread branching forth in different directions.
example_en: The creeper spread branching forth over the wall.

definition: anything made of patches using pieces of different things (as cloth).
example_en: His shirt was full of patchwork made from different pieces of cloth.

definition: the coconut palm.
example_en: Tall coconut palms stood in a row along the seashore.

definition: a sitting, with the body weight being on the feet, legs folded at the knees and without resting the buttocks on the floor.
example_en: The farmers sat in the kukkurukālu posture in the field.

definition: of low or no value, status, importance, etc.
example: ಈ ಹುಳುಕು ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ಯಾವ ಬೆಲೆಯೂ ಇಲ್ಲ.
example_en: This worthless work has no value at all.

definition: to look or become grand.
example_en: The new house looked very grand.

definition: name of one of the hells.
example_en: They say that sinners suffer in the hell named Tamasi.

definition: name of a state, now officially and popularly known as Mahārāṣṭra, in Western India, having Mumbai as its capital.
example: ಪೂರ್ವಜರ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಮರಹಟ್ಟ ಒಂದು ಬಲಿಷ್ಠ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In the time of our ancestors, the Maratha kingdom was a powerful empire.

definition: the water plant Nymphaea alba of Nymphaeaceae family.
example_en: The water lily plant floated on the pond's water.

definition: a pile, esp. of wood, for burning a dead body on; a pyre.
example: ಸಿಧಿಯನ್ನು ಸಿದ್ಧಪಡಿಸಿ ಶವವನ್ನು ಅದರ ಮೇಲೆ ಇಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: They prepared the pyre and placed the body on it.

definition: a kind of war-weapon, used in olden days.
example_en: The soldiers used the war-weapon called maruḷugai in the battle.

definition: the boa Bangarus fasciatus of Homolopsidae family, that has a narrow, yellowish stripes on the body.
example_en: In the forest, a banded krait crawled at the foot of a tree.

definition: a participant in a meeting, assembly.
example_en: That participant actively took part in the meeting's discussion.

definition: a certain quantity of jaggery (a coarse dark brown sugar).
example_en: One measure of jaggery is enough for the payasam.

definition: curly hair.
example_en: The queen's curly hair was adorned with pearls.

definition: (a term at chess) a check by withdrawing one's pawn.
example_en: The player checked the opponent's king with a withdrawing-pawn check.

definition: a rhythmical composition, rhymed or not, expressing experiences, ideas or emotions in meter or free verse, in a highly developed artistic form and imaginative, powerful style than prose; a poem.
example: ಕವಿ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಒಂದು ಪದ್ಯ ಬರೆದನು.
example_en: The poet wrote a poem about nature.

definition: (pl.) two sides (of the same thing).
example_en: Both sides of that plank were carefully carved.

definition: an amalgamating, combining or joining together into one; amalgamation.
example: ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಪಕ್ಷಗಳ ಏಕಕೂಟದಿಂದ ಹೊಸ ಸಂಘಟನೆ ಹುಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: A new organization was born from the amalgamation of all the parties.

definition: a man in charge of a department, institution, etc.; a supervisor; a superintendent.
example_en: The supervisor looks after the account books.

definition: to throw here and there or strew loosely; to scatter.
example_en: The blowing wind scattered the dry grass.

definition: pleasingly; beautifully; in a lovely manner.
example_en: The peacock danced, spreading its feathers in a beautiful manner.

definition: any deity regarded as petty or inferior.
example_en: They worship the petty deity in the village.

definition: moved; made to move; driven.
example_en: This machine is driven by electricity.

definition: distressed; dejected; in low spirits; depressed; disheartened.
example_en: Having failed in the exam, he became dejected.

definition: totally emaciated by losing flesh.
example_en: He became totally emaciated due to the long illness.

definition: the air taken in to the lungs and let out; breath.
example_en: His breath was fast after the run.

definition: (irritation) to happen.
example_en: Irritation happens to him even over small matters.

definition: characterised by adherence to religion or a religion; pious; godly; religious.
example: ಅವನು ಬಹಳ ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ; ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಪೂಜೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: He is a very religious person; he worships every day.

definition: to speak falsely or utter untruth knowingly, as with intent to deceive; to lie.
example_en: A person who lies is called one who bonku's (utters falsehood).

definition: to become perturbed deeply; to be shaken completely.
example: ಆ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವಳ ಮನಸ್ಸು ಘೂರ್ಣಿಸಿತು.
example_en: Hearing that news, her mind was deeply perturbed.

definition: the office and duty of a person who steers a vessel.
example_en: The steering of the ship was entrusted to him.

definition: seedlings raised for transplantation.
example_en: The farmers transplanted seedlings into the paddy field.

definition: to push in with force; to cause to become dense.
example_en: He pushed the soil in with his foot to make it dense.

definition: organising, managing or capable of organising, managing.
example: ಅವನು ಈ ಕಂಪನಿಯ ಸಮರ್ಥ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾಪಕ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿ.
example_en: He is a capable managing officer of this company.

definition: the plant Brassica juncea of Brassicaceae family; mustard plant.
example_en: The mustard plant grew well in the field.

definition: to exchange one thing for another; to barter.
example_en: They barter grain for cloth.

definition: a spiral staircase, usu. having a handrail or balustrade.
example_en: There was a spiral staircase inside the tower.

definition: to immigrate, en masse , from the normal place of living, to settle in another, permanently or for a relatively longer period (esp. necessitated by famine, disaster, etc. or by threat or coercion).
example_en: Because of the drought, the villagers migrated en masse.

definition: the act or fact of conrolling; power to control.
example_en: The control of that work is in his hands.

definition: to raise dust.
example_en: When the wind blew, the vehicle raised dust.

definition: the chief of law and finance departments under whom a large number of clerks are working.
example: ಆ ಮಹಾಕ್ಷಪಟಲಿಕ ಹಲವಾರು ಗುಮಾಸ್ತರ ಕೆಲಸ ಮೇಲ್ವಿಚಾರಣೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That chief of law and finance department supervised the work of many clerks.

definition: college or university education; higher education.
example_en: Higher education is available in this college.

definition: (archit.) the standard measure (equal to three fourth of an inch).
example_en: The sculptor carved the pillar according to the standard measure.

definition: a faithful, trusting person.
example: ಆ ಇತಬಾರಿ ಸೇವಕ ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಮೋಸ ಮಾಡಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That faithful servant never cheated.

definition: to accept bribes.
example_en: He worked honestly without accepting bribes.

definition: freed; released (from bondge, imprisonment, etc.).
example_en: That prisoner was freed from the jail.

definition: the split cashewnut.
example_en: The split cashewnuts were very expensive in the shop.

definition: a long-handled, cuplike spoon for dipping out liquids; a ladle.
example_en: The grandmother took out the milk with a ladle.

definition: to cause to wake from or as from sleep.
example_en: The sound of the shout woke him up.

definition: to put side by side or close together; to juxtapose.
example_en: She juxtaposed two chairs side by side.

definition: the best king among kings.
example_en: All the kings respected that best of kings.

definition: a book in which a record or list of names, events or any other item, are kept; a register.
example_en: The clerk wrote all the details in the register.

definition: any of a class of words used to modify a noun or other substantive; an adjective.
example_en: An adjective describes a noun.

definition: a chief officer (of a department).
example_en: The chief officer managed the department.

definition: a cell, row of cells, band or rod-like structure running across a cavity or forming an internal support to an organ; trabecula.
example: ಎಳದೂಲ ಆ ಅಂಗದ ಒಳಭಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ಆಧಾರ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The trabecula provides support to the inner part of that organ.

definition: a small variety of śami tree (of Mimosae family).
example_en: A small shami tree has grown in the corner of the courtyard.

definition: robbery by organised band of criminals; dacoity.
example_en: The police curbed dacoity in that area.

definition: to joint, associate harmoniously.
example_en: The two families lived joined together in harmony.

definition: being in the very early stage of development; immature.
example_en: This mango is still in an immature state.

definition: a man who moves in the sky.
example_en: The sky-farer flew to a distant city in an airplane.

definition: the state of a person about to die.
example_en: The patient lay in a state of being about to die.

definition: want of wisdom; stupidity.
example_en: Everyone knew of his stupidity.

definition: protected; guarded; defended.
example_en: That fort was protected by soldiers.

definition: an old unit of measure of quantity.
example_en: In the past, grain used to be measured in the omana unit.

definition: any work or works, connected with the main work, to be done outside one's place as house, office, etc.
example_en: Today I have to finish the outside work of the office.

definition: the jet black colour.
example_en: That stone gleamed with a jet black colour.

definition: the act of frying (without using oil, ghee, etc.
example_en: The frying of groundnut seeds took place in the pan.

definition: the tree Erythrina stricta of Papilionaceae family.
example: ಆ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ತಪ್ಪಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮುರುಕು ಮರಗಳು ಹೇರಳವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತವೆ.
example_en: Muruku trees grow abundantly at the foot of that hill.

definition: a fictitious, fake or namesake medicine.
example: ಆ ಅಂಗಡಿಯವನು ಕುಂಟುಮದ್ದು ಮಾರುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಎಂದು ಗೊತ್ತಾಯಿತು.
example_en: It turned out that shopkeeper was selling fake medicine.

definition: overwhelming with sorrow, grief, disappointment, etc.; heart-breaking; heart-rending.
example_en: The news of the child's death was very heart-rending.

definition: (pl.) the two milk secreting glands of a woman; both the breasts of a woman.
example_en: She fed the baby milk from her breasts.

definition: not cool; hot; of burning nature.
example_en: The hot, burning sunshine of summer troubled everyone.

definition: a naturally elevated land.
example_en: The whole town can be seen from that elevated land.

definition: a fight involving exchange of blows with fists, pulling each other etc.
example_en: A fight of exchanging blows and pulling occurred in the quarrel, and both got injured.

definition: a finger-ring used as a seal, esp. as a royal signet-ring.
example_en: The king pressed his signet-ring on the letter.

definition: the state of being lost in the wilderness.
example: ಆ ಬಾಲಕ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಡವಿಪಾಲು ಆಗಿ ಕಳೆದುಹೋದ.
example_en: The boy became lost in the wilderness of the forest.

definition: (an unusual phenomenon) to happen (portending an impending danger).
example: ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ವಿಚಿತ್ರ ಘಟನೆ ಉತ್ಪಾತವಾಗಿ ಸಂಭವಿಸಿತು.
example_en: A strange, portentous event happened in the village.

definition: any thing produced in the course of making another thing; an incidental or secondary product of manufacture etc.; a by-product.
example: ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆಯ ಉಪೋತ್ಪನ್ನ ಬೆಲ್ಲ ಕೂಡ ಆಗಿದೆ.
example_en: Jaggery is also a by-product of sugar production.

definition: an appellation given to a person or family as a sign of privilege, distinction, rank or profession.
example_en: That family received an honorific title from the king.

definition: the tree Premna serratifolia (= P. integrifolia) of Verbenaceae family.
example_en: A naruval tree has grown near the village.

definition: either of two large ruminant mammals [a) one-humped one (Camelus dromedarius) or (b) two-humped one (Camelus bactrianus = C. ferus)], with a long neck, and large, cushioned feet, used as a draft and saddle animal in desert regions esp. of Africa and Asia, being capable of storing water in its body tissue; a camel.
example_en: They travelled on a camel through the desert.

definition: that is to be meditated on; fit for meditation.
example_en: This subject is fit for meditation.

definition: that which is shaken, trembled.
example_en: That leaf, having been shaken, fell in the wind.

definition: to rob or despoil (a person or place) by force.
example_en: The robbers plundered the village by force.

definition: of many kinds; numerous and varied; manifold.
example_en: That book has manifold, varied subjects.

definition: a mean, base man; a man of slight consequence in the society.
example_en: People did not count that mean, base man for anything.

definition: a sinless, virtuous man.
example_en: Everyone in the town respects him as a sinless, virtuous man.

definition: Gangā, the celestial stream.
example: ಬಾಂಬೊಳೆ ಪರ್ವತದಿಂದ ಇಳಿದು ಭೂಮಿಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: They say the celestial Ganga descends from the mountain to the earth.

definition: to get assembled; to prepare oneself with equipments, required facility or arms; etc.
example_en: The soldiers equipped themselves with weapons.

definition: a small pond.
example_en: A small pond could be seen at the edge of the field.

definition: a large, vascular, lymphatic organ in the upper left part of the abdominal cavity of vertebrates, near the stomach, that has various functions in modifying the structure of the blood and forms part of the immune system; the spleen.
example_en: The doctors examined his spleen.

definition: bringing or causing deep trouble, misery or calamity; calamitous.
example_en: That journey turned out to be quite calamitous.

definition: (geol.) a rock formed by or from the deposit of sediment; sedimentary rock.
example_en: Sedimentary rock is commonly found on the river bank.

definition: a man skilled in magic; a magician.
example_en: That magician astonished everyone with his sleight of hand.

definition: single-mindedness.
example_en: His single-mindedness helped him achieve his goal.

definition: to become dampened, moistened or wet.
example_en: Walking in the rain, his clothes became wet.

definition: to make strong or stronger; to strengthen.
example_en: Exercise strengthened his body.

definition: a man whose occupation is whetting of weapons.
example_en: The whetter sharpened the sword on the whetstone.

definition: to move, shake, agitate, etc., slightly ; to shake (oneself).
example_en: The leaves shook slightly in the wind.

definition: (a compound, but used as a single word) 'is it not?'.
example_en: You went there, is it not?

definition: the act of administering; management.
example_en: Under his administration, good happened to the town.

definition: a heavy disk of metal and wood, thrown for distance as a test of strength and skill; a discus.
example_en: He threw the discus very far.

definition: a playing on vioin (as by an expert or professional).
example_en: His violin playing in the hall enchanted everyone.

definition: a man or boy as he is related to the another child or other children of his parents; a brother.
example: ಅವನು ನನ್ನ ಸಹೋತ್ಪನ್ನ, ನಾವು ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಬೆಳೆದೆವು.
example_en: He is my brother; we grew up together.

definition: a ruling over people using brutal power.
example: ಆ ರಾಜನು ಜನರ ಮೇಲೆ ಕ್ರೂರವಾದ ದಬ್ಬಾಳಿಕೆ ನಡೆಸಿದನು.
example_en: That king carried out cruel tyranny over the people.

definition: loveliness that attracts admiration.
example: ಆ ನಟಿಯ ನಾಜೂಕುಗಾರಿಕೆ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: That actress's charming loveliness captivated everyone.

definition: a rough or quarrelsome, bullying person.
example_en: That bullying person always picks fights.

definition: a man, not having required qualification or not being chartered, carrying on the profession of or acting as a lawyer or legal adviser.
example_en: That unqualified lawyer had no knowledge of law.

definition: the instance of the married couple having sexual intercurse for the first time.
example_en: After the first night together, the couple were happy.

definition: grey-haired.
example_en: The grey-haired old man walked slowly.

definition: the hind portion of a ship.
example_en: The hind portion of the ship was damaged by the waves.

definition: a frying pan or a cooking vessel.
example: ಆ ಹಳೆಯ ಋಚೀಷ ಇನ್ನೂ ಅಡುಗೆಗೆ ಬಳಕೆಯಾಗುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That old cooking vessel was still being used for cooking.

definition: a spring or source of water; a fountain.
example_en: A spring of water was found at the foot of the hill.

definition: a place, distant from the native land, where a group of people settle but remain under the political jurisdiction of their native land; a colony.
example: ಆ ನಾಡು ಪರಕೀಯರ ವಸಾಹತ ಆಗಿ ಬಹುಕಾಲ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: That land remained a colony of foreigners for a long time.

definition: a coarse, darg sugar made from the sugar cane juce or from the sap of certain palm trees.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಕಾಫಿಗೆ ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ಬದಲು ಬೆಲ್ಲ ಹಾಕಿದಳು.
example_en: The grandmother added jaggery instead of sugar to the coffee.

definition: the state of being awakened.
example_en: He was awakened by the teacher's words.

definition: a female ruler of a district or region in erstwhile Maratha country.
example_en: The female ruler was governing her district with justice.

definition: a child of one's son or daughter.
example_en: The grandmother gave sweets to her grandchild.

definition: a law and order officer of a district or region.
example_en: The sar subha looks after the law and order of the district.

definition: (pl.) the two crops taken from the agricultural land in a single year.
example: ಈ ಭೂಮಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ರೈತರು ದುಪಿಕಿ ಬೆಳೆ ತೆಗೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The farmers take two crops a year from this land.

definition: the tendency of behaving at one's will or capriciously.
example_en: His capricious behavior troubles everyone.

definition: industrial - a) having the nature of or characterised by industries; b) of, connected with or resulting from industries; c) working in industries; d) of or concerned with people working in industries; e) (said of products) for use by industries.
example: ಈ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಔದ್ಯಮಿಕ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿದೆ.
example_en: Industrial development is happening rapidly in this region.

definition: a servant in the post office who distributes the postal letters to the addressees; a postman.
example_en: The postman delivered a parcel to my house.

definition: not fully ripe; that is about to ripe.
example_en: This banana is about to ripen.

definition: to cease or fail to remember; to be unable to recall.
example_en: As he grew old, he forgot the old things.

definition: the act or an instance of cheating.
example_en: The police found out about that agent's act of cheating.

definition: to pour or cause to flow down continuously.
example_en: She poured the water down continuously from the well.

definition: the act of governing a country.
example_en: The king's governance of the country brought happiness to the subjects.

definition: a man who invades (another's country) with a military force to take away wealth; an invader.
example_en: The people were terrified by the invader's attack.

definition: a visible indication or sign; a symbol; a mark.
example_en: That mark was a symbol of his caste.

definition: sediment suspended in stagnant water or carried by moving water, that often accumulates on the bottom of rivers, bays, etc., esp. such sediment with particles smaller than sand and larger than clay, used to fertilise farm-land.
example: ನದಿಯ ಗೋಡು ರೈತರು ಹೊಲಕ್ಕೆ ಗೊಬ್ಬರವಾಗಿ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Farmers use the river's silt as manure for the field.

definition: the husband of one's sister.
example: ನನ್ನ ಭಾವ ಮದುವೆಗೆ ನಮ್ಮ ಮನೆಗೆ ಬಂದಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: My sister's husband had come to our house for the wedding.

definition: the removal of umbilical cord from the new born baby, immediately after its birth.
example: ಹೆರಿಗೆಯ ನಂತರ ನಾಭಿಖಂಡನ ವೈದ್ಯರ ಉಪಸ್ಥಿತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The cutting of the umbilical cord took place in the presence of a doctor after the delivery.

definition: a loop with a knot that slips along the rope or line around which it is made; a slipknot-loop.
example_en: The hunter placed a slipknot-loop near the path.

definition: separation; partition; division.
example_en: The division of property took place among the brothers.

definition: a person whose work is keeping records, taking care of correspondence and other writing tasks, etc. as for a king, head of the government, etc.; a secretary.
example_en: The secretary handled all of the king's correspondence.

definition: not yielding easily under pressure; solid; hard; firm.
example_en: That stone wall stood firm and solid.

definition: anarchy - a) the complete absence of government; b) political disorder and violence; lawlessness; c) disorder in any sphere of activity; chaos.
example: ದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಸರ್ಕಾರವೇ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಅರಾಜಕ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: A state of anarchy arose in the country with no government at all.

definition: the art of bringing and keeping another spellbound.
example: ಆಕೆ ವಶೀಕಾರಿಣಿ ವಿದ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಕಲಿತಿದ್ದಳೆಂದು ಜನ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: People say she had learnt the art of keeping others spellbound.

definition: the offspring of a donkey and a horse; a mule.
example: ಆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿ ಸಾಮಾನು ಹೊರುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ವಾಜಿತರವನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿದನು.
example_en: That trader used a mule to carry the goods.

definition: the main gate of a town, building, etc.
example_en: The soldiers were standing guard near the main gate of the town.

definition: a choosing or selecting; selection.
example: ಎತ್ತುಗಳಿಗೆ ನೊಗ ಕಟ್ಟುವ ಯೋಜನ ಕಾರ್ಯ ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆಯೇ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The task of yoking the oxen was carried out in the morning itself.

definition: a hollow place in the stem or a branch of a tree.
example_en: A hollow was visible in the branch broken by the storm.

definition: any collection of articles, usu. things used in some activity; goods.
example_en: They readied all the goods needed for the journey.

definition: the act or an instance of delaying.
example_en: Because of his delay, everyone had to wait.

definition: a set of a twin nets, used by the hunters or poachers.
example_en: The hunters set the twin nets in the river.

definition: refined lac, a resin usually produced in thin, flaky layers or shells and used by women in dyeing certain parts of their body.
example_en: She applied refined lac to her hands.

definition: to transgress the boundary; to tresspass.
example: ಅವನು ನನ್ನ ಮನೆಯ ಮೇರೆಗಳೆದು ಒಳಗೆ ಬಂದನು.
example_en: He trespassed across the boundary of my house and came inside.

definition: an indigent, poor man.
example_en: That poor, indigent man was begging on the street.

definition: a burden - that which is carried; a load.
example_en: It was hard to carry that heavy load.

definition: (hist.) a federation of merchants.
example_en: The federation of merchants controlled trade of that era.

definition: the quality or condition of being very much suitable.
example: ಈ ಬಟ್ಟೆಯ ಕರವೊಳ್ಳಿತು ನೋಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಮೆಚ್ಚಿದರು.
example_en: Seeing the great suitability of this cloth, everyone admired it.

definition: a bald head.
example_en: His bald head was shining in the sunlight.

definition: a gift presented on an auspicious occasion.
example_en: On the wedding day, they gave a ceremonial gift to the son-in-law.

definition: an act or instance of dismissing or expelling from an office, position, etc.; dismissal; expulsion.
example_en: Because of his laziness, he received a dismissal from the office.

definition: the plant Brassica juncea of Brassicaceae family; mustard plant.
example_en: The mustard plant is also used as a medicine.

definition: a panting breath.
example: ಬೆಟ್ಟ ಹತ್ತಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವನ ಏದುಸಿರು ಕೇಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: After climbing the hill, his panting breath was heard.

definition: the coldest season of the year (approx. from November to January or mid-February); winter season.
example_en: It is very cold in the mornings during winter.

definition: not auspicious; unfavourable; causing distress; inauspicious.
example_en: An inauspicious omen appeared that day.

definition: an acute shortage or lack, of food.
example_en: There was an acute shortage of food in that village.

definition: a small water tank.
example_en: There was a small water tank near the village.

definition: the cultivated gingili plant oil, Sesamum indicum (family: Pedaliaceae).
example: ರೈತರು ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಊರೆಳ್ಳು ಬೆಳೆಸಿ ಎಣ್ಣೆ ತೆಗೆದರು.
example_en: The farmers grew gingili sesame in the field and extracted oil.

definition: a girl not of full or mature age.
example: ಆಕೆ ಇನ್ನೂ ಅಪ್ರಾಪ್ತವಯಸ್ಕೆ ಎಂದು ಮದುವೆ ಮುಂದೂಡಲಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The marriage was postponed since she was still a minor girl.

definition: any bright, radiant colour.
example_en: A bright radiant colour spread across the sky at dawn.

definition: causing intoxication; intoxicating; intoxicant.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಮಾದಕ ಪದಾರ್ಥಗಳಿಂದ ದೂರವಿರಲು ಸಲಹೆ ನೀಡಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor advised staying away from intoxicating substances.

definition: bad reputation.
example_en: That incident brought him a bad reputation.

definition: a desire; a wish.
example: ವಿದೇಶ ಪ್ರವಾಸದ ಅಭಿಲಾಷೆ ಅವಳ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: She had a desire to travel abroad in her mind.

definition: a mass of things heaped together; a heap; a pile.
example_en: A heap of firewood had grown in the courtyard.

definition: a difficult situation; straits.
example_en: He fell into a difficult situation due to the burden of debt.

definition: a toxic, carcinogenic, colourless, volatile liquid, CHCl3, with a sweet taste, used as a solvent, fumigant, etc. and, formerly, as a general anesthetic; chloroform.
example_en: The doctors used chloroform before the surgery.

definition: an old measure; half-a seer (a little over half a litre).
example_en: The shopkeeper measured out half a seer of oil.
